message.content:
Based on my research, here are three well-designed **7-day China itinerary options** tailored to different travel interests. Each is realistic, well-paced, and uses China's excellent high-speed rail network.

---

## Option 1: Classic First-Timer Route — Beijing & Shanghai

**Best for:** First-time visitors wanting imperial history + modern metropolis

| Day | Destination | Highlights |
|-----|-------------|------------|
| 1 | **Beijing** | Arrive, settle in, evening neighborhood walk near Forbidden City |
| 2 | **Beijing** | Forbidden City (3-4 hrs), Summer Palace, Peking duck dinner |
| 3 | **Beijing** | Great Wall at **Mutianyu** (less crowded than Badaling), Ming Tombs |
| 4 | **Beijing** | Temple of Heaven, Yonghe Temple, hutong exploration |
| 5 | **Beijing → Shanghai** | Morning G-train (4.5–5.5 hrs), evening Bund stroll |
| 6 | **Shanghai** | Yu Garden, French Concession, Pudong skyline/Oriental Pearl Tower |
| 7 | **Shanghai** | Morning free for shopping/markets, fly out from PVG/SHA |

**Logistics:** One long G-train leg. Fly into Beijing, out of Shanghai. Many nationalities qualify for **240-hour visa-free transit** or **30-day unilateral visa-free** entry in 2026—confirm based on your passport.

---

## Option 2: The Golden Triangle — Beijing, Xi'an & Shanghai

**Best for:** Travelers wanting the Terracotta Warriors (busier pace)

| Day | Destination | Highlights |
|-----|-------------|------------|
| 1 | **Beijing** | Arrive, evening rest |
| 2 | **Beijing** | Forbidden City, Summer Palace |
| 3 | **Beijing** | Great Wall (Mutianyu), Ming Tombs |
| 4 | **Beijing → Xi'an** | Morning flight (2.5 hrs), afternoon city walls, Muslim Quarter |
| 5 | **Xi'an** | Terracotta Army (full day), Big Goose Pagoda |
| 6 | **Xi'an → Shanghai** | Morning flight (3 hrs), Bund at sunset |
| 7 | **Shanghai** | Yu Garden, French Concession, evening departure |

**Note:** This is airport-style pacing with 2 flights. Save this for energetic travelers; add 3 more nights for a relaxed 10-day version.

---

## Option 3: East China Cultural Triangle — Shanghai, Suzhou & Hangzhou

**Best for:** Garden lovers, tea culture, easy train hops, minimal hotel changes

| Day | Destination | Highlights |
|-----|-------------|------------|
| 1–3 | **Shanghai** | The Bund, Yu Garden, French Concession, museums, neighborhood walks |
| 4 | **Suzhou** | Day trip or overnight: classical gardens (Humble Administrator's Garden), Pingjiang Road canals |
| 5–7 | **Hangzhou** | West Lake boat ride, Longjing tea villages, Lingyin Temple, fly out from Hangzhou or return to Shanghai |

**Logistics:** All connections via short high-speed trains (30 min Shanghai–Suzhou, ~1.5 hrs Suzhou–Hangzhou). Very relaxed pacing with only 2–3 hotel changes.

---

## Practical Tips for All Itineraries

| Topic | Advice |
|-------|--------|
| **Best seasons** | Spring (April–May) or Autumn (September–October) |
| **Currency** | Chinese Yuan (CNY); carry cash—many places don't take foreign cards |
| **Payments** | Set up Alipay/WeChat Pay or use cash; download translation apps |
| **Internet** | Get a VPN *before* arriving if you need Google/social media |
| **Trains** | Book in advance for weekends/holidays; use 12306 app or Trip.com |
| **Forbidden City** | Tickets sell out—book online in advance |

---

## Alternative: Nature & Culture Routes

- **Yunnan (Kunming → Dali → Lijiang):** Ethnic minorities, Erhai Lake, Jade Dragon Mountain, "Shangri-La" Tibetan culture
- **Guilin–Yangshuo:** Karst landscapes, Li River, cormorant fishing, rural cycling
- **Chengdu + Zhangjiajie:** Giant pandas, Avatar mountains, glass skywalks

---

Sources:
1. https://startchinatravel.com/7-day-china-itinerary-first-timers-2026/

4. https://chinawithease.com/itineraries/beijing-xian-shanghai/
5. https://webuytravel.sg/faq/best-7-day-china-itinerary
